decisions.statement: Every category chain gets ALL_CATEGORIES_ID prepended ahead of the caller's node ids.
An item key is resolved from the item name only for recipes and motif books and scripts.
Potion effect metric ids come from the potionData field parsed out of the item link.
An item type the resolver does not name is left with no item key.

definition: the evaluable facts of one item, projected out of the game client's inventory item record
